summary.text: Josh Bonner, a Republican, has represented Georgia House District 73 since being sworn in on January 9, 2017, and chairs the House Defense and Veterans Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: His official biography says he owns Southeast Properties, Inc., a commercial asset management and brokerage firm.

The biography says Bonner graduated from the University of Georgia, was commissioned in the U.S. Army, served as a military intelligence officer on active duty, and later moved to the Army Reserves, including a deployment to Iraq.
